title: Add storage affinity helpers and init node-drain job templating for safer tenant seed
author: Asha Kumar
release_notes: Added: storageAffinity values and helper templates; Added: init node-drain job to run as an optional pre-seed hook; Changed: default nodeSelector relaxed for multi-zone clusters; Docs: examples for air-gapped storage overlays.
description:
Motivation: On several on-prem clusters we observed tenant-seed jobs failing due to node disk pressure or mismatched storage class locality. This PR introduces a declarative storageAffinity section in values.schema.yaml and a templated init node-drain Job that can be enabled for clusters which require cordon/drain before heavy init workloads. The change keeps defaults conservative (disabled) and adds comprehensive Helm unit tests and chart lint fixes.

What this changes:
- values.schema.yaml: add storageAffinity (storageClass -> nodeLabel selectors) and preflight.drainConfig block with toggles and timeouts.
- templates/_helpers-storage.tpl: new templating helpers to render affinity/nodeSelector for PVC-backed components. Helpers support wildcard matching and per-tenant overrides via values.overlays.
- templates/init-node-drain-job.yaml: opt-in Job (hook-like behaviour) that uses the cluster kubeconfig secret to cordon and drain a set of nodes matching a selector, waits for PodDisruptionBudget checks, and annotates progress to a CRD-like ConfigMap for visibility. Meant to run before tenant-seed/migrate hooks.
- templates/tests/*: add helm-unittest cases covering templating and dry-run path for drain job and affinity helper rendering.
- README-private/values-examples.md: document new keys, show storage affinity examples for common SAN/NFS/GCE/GKE onprem setups (examples emphasize non-default storageClass names).

Backward compatibility: All new features are gated behind explicit values flags (preflight.drain.enabled, storageAffinity.enabled). Default behavior remains unchanged. The storageAffinity schema allows empty map which equates to previous behavior.

Usage notes: To enable node-drain preflight set preflight.drain.enabled=true and provide a kubeconfigSecret name and optional preflight.drain.nodeSelector to narrow impacted nodes. For air-gapped installs, examples show how to map storage classes to node labels so PVC scheduling prefers local disks.

review_comments: Samir Patel (2025-10-29): Can we avoid introducing node-drain behavior by default? Suggest default=false and add strong docs for risks. Also request an optional backoff/timeout to prevent long-running preflight stalls.
Asha Kumar (2025-10-29): Agree, defaults are disabled. Added preflight.drain.timeoutSeconds and preflight.drain.retries and documented failure modes in README-private.

Asha Kumar (2025-10-30): Added sanitised dry-run annotations and test cases. Dry-run uses --grace-period=0 + annotation skip to avoid actual evictions.

merge_result: Merged by squash on 2025-11-02 (merge method: squash). Commit message cleaned to include storageAffinity and preflight drain summary.
notes_for_ops: Operators: to enable, set preflight.drain.enabled=true and reference your kubeconfig secret via preflight.drain.kubeconfigSecret. For clusters with custom storage classes, populate values.storageAffinity.map with storageClass:nodeLabel mappings. See README-private/values-examples.md for concrete examples. The job respects podDisruptionBudget checks and will abort if safe eviction cannot be satisfied after retries.
